parsed.name: 是德科技 MXRxx4A 四通道示波器
parsed.description: MXRxx4A 是一类台式四通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电子信号波形。它适合实验室中的电路调试、时序分析、信号完整性检查以及通用电子测量。
parsed.description_en: The MXRxx4A is a benchtop 4-channel digital oscilloscope used to capture, display, and analyze electrical waveforms. It is suited for laboratory tasks such as circuit debugging, timing analysis, signal integrity checks, and general electronic measurements.

actions.description: 测量并读取当前测量项目的统计结果。
actions.description_en: Measure and read the statistics for the current measurement items.
